leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement ::before and ::after pseudo-elements on HTML elements
Configure content property values for generated pseudo-elements
Apply CSS styling rules to customize pseudo-element appearance
Construct decorative elements using pseudo-elements without modifying HTML
Manipulate pseudo-element positioning relative to their parent elements
Integrate pseudo-elements with existing CSS selectors and rules
Initialize pseudo-elements with different content types (text, icons, images)
